# Valuation Insights

## Profitability
CoreWeave’s fiscal 2025 revenue grew 167.9% to $5,131 million, but operating income swung from a $324 million profit in fiscal 2024 to a $46 million loss in fiscal 2025. <!-- [source: ratio|operation=divide|inputs=5131000000;1915000000|result=1.6794|definition=revenue growth] -->
The resulting operating margin is -0.9% in fiscal 2025, a sharp deterioration from the 16.9% margin achieved in fiscal 2024. <!-- [source: ratio|operation=divide|inputs=-46000000;5131000000|result=-0.009|definition=operating income / total revenue] -->
Score: 1/5.

## Cash Conversion
Cash from operations increased to $3,058 million in fiscal 2025, but capital expenditures of $10,309 million produced negative free cash flow of $(7,251) million. <!-- [source: xbrl|tag=us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities|period=2025-01-01:2025-12-31|value=3058000000] -->
The prior year also showed negative free cash flow of $(5,953) million, indicating that operating cash has not yet covered the heavy infrastructure buildout. <!-- [source: ratio|operation=subtract|inputs=3058000000;10309000000|result=-7251000000|definition=cash from operations - additions to property and equipment] -->
Score: 1/5.

## Financial Strength
Return on average equity was -79.9% in fiscal 2025, reflecting a $1,167 million net loss against an average equity base of $1,460.5 million that was negative at the start of the year. <!-- [source: ratio|operation=divide|inputs=-1167000000;1460500000|result=-0.799|definition=net income / average stockholders' equity] -->
Total debt rose from $7,926 million to $21,373 million in 2025, raising the debt-to-equity ratio to 6.41x versus 1.92x in the prior period. <!-- [source: xbrl|tag=us-gaap:LongTermDebtNoncurrent|period=2025-12-31|value=14665000000] -->
Score: 1/5.

## Valuation
A P/E ratio cannot be calculated because the fiscal 2025 diluted EPS was $(2.81), and no market price was supplied. <!-- [source: xbrl|tag=us-gaap:EarningsPerShareDiluted|period=2025-01-01:2025-12-31|value=-2.81] -->
Score: 1/5.

Insight: Third quarter 2026 GAAP operating income was $207 million, a 298% increase over the $52 million reported in the same quarter of 2025. <!-- [source: line|file=8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt|line=28] -->
